slides.title: itertools in Functional Pipelines
slides.prompt: The 'itertools' module provides powerful iterator building blocks for memory-efficient functional processing, such as chain(), starmap(), dropwhile(), and takewhile().
slides.codeSnippet:
import itertools

# chain
combined = list(itertools.chain([1, 2], [3, 4]))  # [1, 2, 3, 4]

# takewhile
nums = [1, 3, 5, 2, 4]
res = list(itertools.takewhile(lambda x: x < 5, nums))  # [1, 3]

slides.title: starmap vs map
slides.prompt: What is the key difference between itertools.starmap() and built-in map()?
options: starmap unpacks argument tuples from the iterable into the function calls (*args)
